title: Comprehensive Multi-Omics Identification of Interferon-gamma Response Characteristics Reveals That RBCK1 Regulates the Immunosuppressive Microenvironment of Renal Cell Carcinoma.
authors: Xu, Wenhao; Tao, Juli; Zhu, Wenkai; Liu, Wangrui; Anwaier, Aihetaimujiang; Tian, Xi; Su, Jiaqi; Shi, Guohai; Huang, Haineng; Wei, Gaomeng; Li, Chuanyu; Qu, Yuanyuan; Zhang, Hailiang; Ye, Dingwei
one_liner_zh: 该文为肾细胞癌IFN-γ反应特征的多组学生物标志物与免疫微环境研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Interferon-gamma (IFN-gamma) has a complex role in modulating the tumor microenvironment (TME) during renal cell carcinoma (RCC) development. To define the role of IFN-gamma response genes in RCC progression, we characterized the differential gene expression, prognostic implications, and DNA variation profiles of selected IFN-gamma response signatures, which exhibited a significant hazard ratio for the overall survival (OS) and progression-free survival (PFS) of papillary, chromophobia, and clear cell RCC (ccRCC) patients (n = 944). Prognostic nomograms were constructed to predict the outcomes for ccRCC patients, highlighting the prognostic implications of RANBP2-type and C3HC4-type zinc finger containing 1 (RBCK1). Interestingly, large-scale pan-cancer samples (n = 12,521) and three single-cell RNA datasets revealed that RBCK1 showed markedly differential expression between cancer and normal tissues and significantly correlated with tumor-infiltrating immune cells, tumor purity, and immune checkpoint molecules, such as PD-L1, CTLA-4, LAG-3, and TIGIT in pan-cancer samples. Notably, the TIDE score was significantly higher in the RBCK1(high) group compared with the RBCK1(low) group in both ccRCC and RCC cohorts. Besides, immunohistochemistry staining showed significantly elevated RBCK1 expression in tumors (n = 50) compared with kidney samples (n = 40) from a real-world cohort, Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center (FUSCC, Shanghai). After RBCK1 expression was confirmed in ccRCC, we found a significantly decreased number of infiltrating CD4(+) T cells, CD4(+) FOXP3(+) Treg cells, M1 macrophages, and CD56(bight/dim) NK cells in the immune-cold RBCK1(high) group. In addition to the distinct heterogeneous immune microenvironment, the increased expression of RBCK1 predicted a prominently worse prognosis than the RBCK1(low) group for 232 ccRCC patients in the FUSCC proteomic cohort. Furthermore, after transfected with siRNA in human ccRCC cells, extraordinarily decreased cell proliferation, migration capacities, and prominently elevated apoptosis tumor cell proportion were found in the siRNA groups compared with the negative control group. In conclusion, this study identified IFN-gamma response clusters, which might be used to improve the prognostic accuracy of immune contexture in the ccRCC microenvironment. Immune-cold RBCK1(high) patients have pro-tumorigenic immune infiltration and significantly worse outcomes than RBCK1(low) patients based on results from multi-omics to real-world data. Our discovery of novel independent prognostic indicators for RCC highlights the association between tumor alterations and immune phenotype.
abstract_zh: 干扰素-γ（IFN-gamma）在肾细胞癌（RCC）发展过程中对肿瘤微环境（TME）的调节具有复杂作用。为明确IFN-gamma应答基因在RCC进展中的作用，我们表征了所选IFN-gamma应答特征（signatures）的差异基因表达、预后意义及DNA变异谱，这些特征对乳头状、嫌色性和透明细胞RCC（ccRCC）患者（n = 944）的总生存期（OS）和无进展生存期（PFS）表现出显著的风险比（hazard ratio）。构建了预后列线图（nomograms）以预测ccRCC患者的结局，突出了RANBP2型和C3HC4型锌指蛋白1（RBCK1）的预后意义。有趣的是，大规模泛癌样本（n = 12,521）和三个单细胞RNA数据集显示，RBCK1在癌症与正常组织之间表现出显著差异表达，并与肿瘤浸润免疫细胞、肿瘤纯度及免疫检查点分子（如PD-L1、CTLA-4、LAG-3和TIGIT）在泛癌样本中显著相关。值得注意的是，在ccRCC和RCC队列中，RBCK1高表达组的TIDE评分显著高于RBCK1低表达组。此外，免疫组化染色显示，在来自真实世界队列（复旦大学上海癌症中心，FUSCC，上海）的肿瘤样本（n = 50）中，RBCK1表达显著高于肾脏样本（n = 40）。在确认ccRCC中RBCK1表达后，我们发现免疫冷型RBCK1高表达组中浸润性CD4(+) T细胞、CD4(+) FOXP3(+) Treg细胞、M1巨噬细胞和CD56(bright/dim) NK细胞数量显著减少。除了独特的异质性免疫微环境外，在FUSCC蛋白质组学队列的232名ccRCC患者中，RBCK1表达升高预测的预后显著差于RBCK1低表达组。此外，在人ccRCC细胞中转染siRNA后，与阴性对照组相比，siRNA组的细胞增殖能力、迁移能力显著降低，肿瘤细胞凋亡比例显著升高。总之，本研究识别了IFN-gamma应答簇，这可能有助于提高ccRCC微环境中免疫背景的预后准确性。基于从多组学到真实世界数据的结果，免疫冷型RBCK1高表达患者具有促肿瘤免疫浸润，且预后显著差于RBCK1低表达患者。我们发现的RCC新型独立预后指标强调了肿瘤改变与免疫表型之间的关联。
